gates.real_path_exercised: 1 of the 4 named mechanisms now has dedicated real-path coverage: NARASI_FRONTMATTER_STRIP, exercised via narration_api._apply_v3_gates() with an engineered Sinopsis/Target preamble (>400 chars) followed by a bare 'Chapter 1:' heading -- proving flag-off leaves the preamble in place, flag-on strips it while preserving the chapter body, a too-short (<400 char) preamble never fires even with the flag on, and a long preamble lacking any brief marker (Sinopsis/Target/markdown header) never fires either, confirming all three source-verified trigger conditions (bare heading + length threshold + marker presence) empirically rather than by source reading alone
